title: chart-qa-failures.json
description: Sidecar payload emitted by the Chart QA export on /chart-preview when 'Include failure JSON' is enabled. Produced by buildFailuresPayload in src/lib/chartQaFailuresPayload.ts. The `environment` property is optional and is HARD-OMITTED (the key is fully absent — not null, not undefined, not {}) whenever `environmentIncluded` is false.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 client timestamp at export time.

viewport.description: Rendered viewport label, e.g. '1280px' or 'full width'.

enabledChartTypes.description: Chart type IDs included in the sweep.

appTheme.description: Theme active when the export ran.

environmentIncluded.description: Mirrors the 'Include environment block' toggle. When false, the `environment` property MUST be absent from this document.

expectedSeriesOrder.description: Human-readable series labels in the order the UI expects to render.

fullSweep.description: Per-step PASS/FAIL for both themes, run duration, and overall counts. Shape is intentionally open — treat as opaque for schema validation.

failures.description: Interaction-tester failures captured during the sweep. May be empty.

environment.description: Runtime environment snapshot. Present ONLY when environmentIncluded is true. When environmentIncluded is false, this property MUST NOT appear in the document (see allOf branch below).

allOf.title: environment presence is gated by environmentIncluded

then.description: When environmentIncluded is false the `environment` key MUST be completely absent from the document — not null, not an empty object.

else.description: When environmentIncluded is true the `environment` key MUST be present.
